The '''Pinett system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and contained the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Pinett]].
